extraction.prefetch_policy: Two worker processes, prefetch_factor=2 batches per worker (at most four prefetched batches / 64 original-image rows); persistent workers within a source/split loader lifetime; retain manifest order.
extraction.encoder_calls: E1: global only. E2: global first then one batch-major call of all four locals; no crop chunking

batch_shapes.tail_policy: Retain actual B rows, no padding, duplication or drop; global/features use B, locals use [B,4,...] and flattened locals [4*B,...]

extraction.loader_order_policy: Sequential manifest-ordered batches; shuffle=false, in_order=true, drop_last=false. Worker completion order cannot reorder published rows. Workers perform deterministic CPU decode/preprocessing only; model execution remains in the main CUDA process.
extraction.worker_rng_policy: Use the isolated extraction loader generator derived from the existing loader_parts with stage=acceptance_fixture and the corresponding source root seed for bounded acceptance, or stage=final and root_seed=source_seed for authorized bulk extraction; split is train or val. For worker_id 0/1 seed Python and NumPy from torch.initial_seed() modulo 2**32 and preserve the Torch worker seed. No extraction augmentation or worker RNG consumption may alter features.
extraction.prefetch_recovery_policy: Only fully committed chunks count as completed work. On interruption discard all uncommitted batches, worker queues, pinned buffers and temporary chunks; recreate the loader and workers at the first row of the first uncommitted chunk using the same source/split/root/stream and manifest order. Prefetched rows grant no coverage or progress credit; revalidate existing committed chunks before reuse.
